description: Returns one published item by ID or slug: title, URL, dates, author, featured image, terms, body as Markdown, and ACF custom fields. Works for any post type (see list_post_types).

id.description: Post ID. Provide either id or slug.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of body text (and of each long ACF text field) to return

slug.description: Post slug. Provide either id or slug.

name: get_post
title: Get a post, page, or custom post
